# Direct formatted native strings replace historical XML scratch buffers

The 1360 XML emitter reland sends nsPrintfCString directly to UtilityWrite for the attachment count and opening attachment tag, replacing two fixed scratch arrays. This is a dated native string-formatting pattern, with an explicit formatting-header include. The emitter path is absent from the fixed accepted tree, so the historical XML forms are not claimed as current implementation or a new project-wide mandate. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/mime/emitters.
